Name: (CP) Leah Cleavage Sprite
Author: Whiteshade5
Description:
An update of my sprite mod for Lewd Bachelorettes Portrait mod. (But now that mod is outdated.)
I still wanted to fix the bow legs and make it 1.4 compatible. (Also 1.6 compatible)
Updated version of my Leah cleavage sprite with winter for 1.6 with no bow legs.

You need Content Patcher for this! Get it, it makes asset modding much easier.

[u]To Install:[/u]
Unzip the folder and put it in your Mods folder.

-If someone would like to make a portrait for this mod, feel free. I am not very good at portraits. So please let me know if you do. :)

*Right now I am using an edited version of Baechu's Portrait but for my personal use only. I can't get in contact for permission to upload the portrait since I don't know Korean and the hosted website is hard to navigate for me.

Downloads.Description:
This version has some edits to the shoulders and the pants, and a few other parts.
Overall better, for an example look at picture 3 labelled 1.1 version.
